def f(g):
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    shape=[k for k in c if k!=bg][0]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==shape]
    rs=[i for i,_ in cells]; cs=[j for _,j in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            onborder = i in (r0,r1) or j in (c0,c1)
            if onborder and g[i][j]!=shape:
                # check it's an isolated single-cell gap: neighbors along the border are shape
                if i in (r0,r1):
                    horiz = (c0<j-1 and g[i][j-1]==shape and j+1<=c1 and g[i][j+1]==shape)
                else:
                    horiz = False
                if j in (c0,c1):
                    vert = (r0<i-1 and g[i-1][j]==shape and i+1<=r1 and g[i+1][j]==shape)
                else:
                    vert=False
                if horiz or vert:
                    out[i][j]=2
    return out

import json
def f(g):
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    shape=[k for k in c if k!=bg and c[k]>4][0]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==shape]
    rs=[i for i,_ in cells]; cs=[j for _,j in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    hrows=[r for r in range(r0,r1+1) if sum(g[r][j]==shape for j in range(c0,c1+1))*2>=(c1-c0+1)]
    vcols=[col for col in range(c0,c1+1) if sum(g[i][col]==shape for i in range(r0,r1+1))*2>=(r1-r0+1)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in hrows:
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            if g[r][j]==bg: out[r][j]=2
    for col in vcols:
        for i in range(r0,r1+1):
            if g[i][col]==bg: out[i][col]=2
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
